### A Prayer for “Guarding What’s Been Entrusted to You”
Author: Chelsey DeMatteis
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-guarding-whats-been-entrusted-to-you.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:20
Points:
- Believers must actively discern what God has entrusted to them through a kingdom perspective.
- Alongside the gospel, our personal testimonies are vital deposits given to us to share.
- Just like the biblical shepherds, Christians should respond boldly and obediently to God's truth.
- Viewing everything in life as entrusted by God roots out pride and fosters humble service.

### Guarding the Deposit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/guarding-deposit
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:20-21
Points:
- The command to guard God's revelation belongs to the entire church body.
- The gospel is a sacred deposit that must be kept safe and returned unchanged.
- Believers must resist watering down doctrine to appease worldly sensibilities.
- Guarding the faith against empty speculation requires total dependence on God's sustaining grace.
